scope: TATG actor PPO interface only; no environment, sampler, reward, critic or evaluation change

collection.state_before_rollout: store the exact TATGRuntimeStateBank payload before the first rollout action
collection.state_after_action: record each sampled own action in the state bank
collection.episode_boundary: after a completed environment resets, reset only that state-bank slot from the newly reset legal graph before the following actor call

actor_update.sequence_rule: recompute actor logits in chronological order for every complete vectorized-environment sequence; no random flattening of time-environment graph rows
actor_update.epoch_rule: every PPO epoch replays the same complete rollout sequences from the stored state-before-rollout payload
actor_update.minibatch_rule: initial TATG qualification uses the frozen full rollout as one sequence minibatch; temporal chunks, burn-in and truncated BPTT are prohibited until separately audited
actor_update.actions: use the stored rollout actions only to advance a_previous after each policy log-probability computation
actor_update.critic: retain the existing snapshot centralized critic and its ordinary PPO value loss
actor_update.objective: retain ordinary clipped PPO actor objective, entropy term, optimizer, epochs, reward and environment

controls.snapshot: unchanged snapshot SG-MAPPO actor under the existing flattened PPO update
controls.generic_gnn_gru: same sequence PPO runner, same full-sequence minibatch and same temporal-head capacity, but current topology input at every step
controls.cetm_ablation: same sequence PPO runner with transition residual forced to zero

forbidden: random flattened time-environment minibatches for a temporal actor
actor hidden state reconstructed from evaluation or return
adaptive sampling, group weighting, selector, fallback or teacher
environment rollout, evaluation or cloud training during C2.5
pass_authorizes_only: a separately frozen sequence-runner implementation and same-rollout PPO correctness audit
